name: Macro Texture Detail
description: An extreme close-up on the product's own surface — no full silhouette, no context, just genuine material texture and craftsmanship filling the frame. The register of a luxury-house detail shot, not a full packshot.
lighting: Single soft raking light, real specular grain
subject: product
prompt: an extreme macro close-up filling the entire frame with the product's own surface — a fragment of label edge, a stitched seam, a brushed-metal grain, or a glass facet, whichever the material actually offers — genuine texture responding to a single soft raking light from one side so real grain, weave, or brushed-metal striations catch true specular highlights rather than a smoothed digital sheen, razor-shallow depth of field with only a thin plane in true focus, the rest dissolving into soft creamy blur, no full product silhouette visible, no background beyond soft out-of-focus neutral tone, no props, no hands, no second object in frame, immaculate close-range commercial clarity
